name: Product specs - internal Luna high web research + Sol audit (no Exa)

parameters.formDescription: Upload a D365 .xlsx workbook with product names and codes. Luna researches it; Sol audits the evidence.

parameters.jsCode:
const m=$input.first().json;
let instructions="Research the supplied product and fill empty fields. For prefilled fields, research only when flagged as unverified; preserve existing values unchanged. Resolve exact product configuration from product code/name, identifiers, model, CPU/GPU, display, RAM/storage, and region. Never transfer values between sibling variants. Apply each supplied D365 field definition, datatype, and unit.\n\n"
+"UNIVERSAL RESEARCH ESCALATION PROTOCOL (FOR ANY PRODUCT):\n"
+"1. Primary: Search official manufacturer technical specifications, user manuals, and EU EPREL product records.\n"
+"2. Regulatory & Certification Fallback: If engineering specifications (such as battery capacity in mAh, Bluetooth core version, RF bands, or charging input voltage) are omitted from consumer marketing pages, systematically search official certification databases: Bluetooth SIG QDID database (bluetooth.com) for Bluetooth specs; FCC ID / CE regulatory filings (fcc.gov, fccid.io) for battery capacity (mAh) and RF ratings; and EU EPREL (eprel.ec.europa.eu) for displays and energy ratings.\n"
+"3. Independent Lab Fallback: If still unstated, escalate to approved independent testing labs and hardware teardowns: RTINGS, SoundGuys, iFixit, 52audio, GSMArena, and PhoneDB. State in fallbackReason why higher tiers lacked the specification.\n\n"
+"CATEGORY-AGNOSTIC PHYSICAL SEMANTICS:\n"
+"- In-ear headphones and earbuds: Stereo_speakers must be false/Ne (drivers are not device speakers); Audio_system must be 'Nėra' unless a third-party co-brand/standard is explicitly present; Shockproof must be false/Ne unless drop-certified.\n"
+"- Mobile devices (Phones, Tablets, Watches): Barcode_sensor and Air_humidity_sensor are always false/Ne. Shockproof is false/Ne unless the manufacturer states military-standard (MIL-STD-810) shock or drop testing, in any wording (e.g. 'tested to US military standards'). Thermometer_sensor is true/Taip only when the manufacturer lists a temperature sensor (including skin-temperature sensing); otherwise false/Ne.\n"
+"- Wi-Fi-only SKUs (Tablets, Laptops): Cellular fields (3G, 4G, 5G, eSIM, 5G_Tele2_Support) must be false/Ne, SIM_count is 0, SIM_type is 'Nėra', and GPS is false/Ne if the device lacks standalone GNSS hardware.\n"
+"- Smartwatches: 2G EDGE and GPRS are false/Ne. Bluetooth/GPS-only models without LTE: eSIM is false/Ne. Documented 5ATM or higher pool-swimming supports Waterproof=true/Taip.\n"
+"- Laptops & TVs: Legacy interfaces (Firewire, DVI, SCSI, Optical drive, VGA, 3D_View) are 0 or false/Ne. If a computer has integrated graphics only, Discrete_video_card must be 'Nėra'. A laptop webcam maps to Main_camera.\n"
+"- Feature phones (keypad phones with a non-smartphone OS): Fingerprint_sensor, Face_recognition_sensor, Gyroscope, Compass, Barometer and Pedometer are false/Ne unless the manufacturer lists them. A phone whose only camera is the main/rear camera has Front_camera 'Nėra'.\n"
+"- Complete lists: when the manufacturer publishes a complete list of physical components of one kind (ports/interfaces, wireless radios, cameras) and a component of that kind is not in it, that component is false/Ne or 0; quote the list. Never conclude that a feature or function (fast charging, wireless charging, step counting/pedometer, payments, water resistance) is absent only because a source does not mention it. Step counting by any built-in sensor means Pedometer true/Taip.\n"
+"- Materials: Map disclosed body/casing, frame, earhook, cushion, and tip materials to the closest allowed multi-material enum (e.g. 'Plastikas, silikonas, metalas').\n\n"
+"Put exactly one URL in each url field. Each value must be the bare value only (no explanations, alternatives or parentheses); put explanations in quote or fallbackReason. Output compact JSON only: {\"values\":{\"field_key\":{\"value\":...,\"quote\":\"...\",\"url\":\"...\",\"sourceTier\":\"1|1b|3\",\"sourceType\":\"...\",\"fallbackReason\":\"...\"}},\"coverage\":{\"field_key\":{\"status\":\"not_published|not_applicable|conflicting_evidence|research_incomplete\",\"reason\":\"...\",\"checkedUrls\":[\"...\"]}}}. Keep JSON concise.";
const SOURCE_POLICY={
 Phones:"Tier 1 official brand specifications and applicable public EPREL records; Tier 1b Wi-Fi Alliance, Bluetooth SIG, and FCC ID regulatory filings (fcc.gov, fccid.io) for certified RF and battery ratings; Tier 2 Google Play supported devices CSV and Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 fallback sources Wikipedia, GSMArena, and PhoneDB may provide values when no applicable Tier 1/Tier 1b evidence is found and no conflict exists.",
 Tablets:"Tier 1 official brand specifications and applicable public EPREL records; Tier 1b Wi-Fi Alliance, Bluetooth SIG, and FCC ID regulatory filings for exact certified fields and battery capacities; Tier 2 Google Play supported devices CSV and Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 fallback sources Wikipedia, GSMArena, and PhoneDB may provide values when no Tier 1/Tier 1b evidence is found and no conflict exists.",
 Laptops:"Tier 1 official brand documentation, Lenovo PSREF for Lenovo configurations, and applicable public EPREL records; Tier 1b Wi-Fi Alliance and Bluetooth SIG for certified fields; Tier 2 Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 Wikipedia and exact-configuration listings from established retailers (including Amazon, Best Buy, Challenger, Kotsovolos, PC International, Intelec, FinalDrive, and in Europe ELKO, 1a, RD Electronics, Euronics, Pigu/220.lv, Varle, Tele2 shops, Alza, Coolblue, MediaMarkt and Currys) may support fallback values only when the exact marketed configuration is explicit, two independent listings agree, and no Tier 1/Tier 1b evidence conflicts.",
 TV:"Tier 1 official brand documentation and applicable public EPREL records; Tier 2 Google Play supported devices CSV and Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 DisplaySpecifications and RTINGS may provide fallback values for panel refresh rate, contrast ratio, and display specs when no applicable Tier 1 evidence or conflict exists.",
 Smartwatches:"Tier 1 official brand documentation and public EPREL records; Tier 1b Bluetooth SIG and FCC ID filings for exact certified RF and battery specs; Tier 2 Google Play supported devices CSV and Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 Wikipedia and GSMArena may provide fallback values when no applicable Tier 1/Tier 1b evidence or conflict exists.",
 Headphones:"Tier 1 brand pages/manuals (including beatsbydre.com, apple.com); Tier 1b Bluetooth SIG, FCC ID regulatory records (fcc.gov, fccid.io) for battery capacity and RF specs; Tier 2 Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 RTINGS, SoundGuys, iFixit, 52audio, and GSMArena may provide fallback values when Tier 1/Tier 1b omits them and no conflict exists.",
 Speakers:"Tier 1 brand pages/manuals; Tier 1b Bluetooth SIG and FCC ID filings for RF and battery ratings; Tier 2 Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 RTINGS and SoundGuys may provide fallback values when no Tier 1/Tier 1b evidence or conflict exists.",
 Cameras:"Tier 1 brand pages/manuals; Tier 2 Wikidata for identity only; Tier 3 DPReview and Wikipedia may provide fallback values when no Tier 1 evidence or conflict exists.",
 Routers:"Tier 1 brand pages; Tier 1b Wi-Fi Alliance for explicitly certified Wi-Fi fields; Tier 2 Wikidata for identity only.",
 "Other network":"Tier 1 brand pages; Tier 1b Wi-Fi Alliance for explicitly certified Wi-Fi fields; Tier 2 Wikidata for identity only.",
 "Phone accessories":"Tier 1 brand pages; Tier 1b USB-IF for USB-PD certified fields, Qi/WPC for explicitly listed Qi fields, and Apple MFi for MFi certification; Tier 2 Open Products Facts for identity only.",
 "General accessories":"Tier 1 brand pages; Tier 2 Open Products Facts for identity only.",
 Other:"Tier 1 brand pages; Tier 2 Open Products Facts for identity only."
};
const categoryPolicy=SOURCE_POLICY[m.category]||(/phone/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Phones:/tablet/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Tablets:/laptop|computer/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Laptops:/tv|television|monitor|display/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.TV:/watch/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Smartwatches:/headphone|earbud/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Headphones:/speaker/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Speakers:/camera/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Cameras:/router/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Routers:/network/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY['Other network']:/vacuum/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY.Other:/smart.home/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY['Other network']:/accessor/i.test(m.category)?SOURCE_POLICY['General accessories']:SOURCE_POLICY.Other);
instructions+='\n\nAPPROVED PUBLIC SOURCE POLICY (no registration, account, or API key): '+categoryPolicy+' Tier 1: official brand documentation and public EPREL product records, with EPREL approved at the same evidence level as brand documentation for the exact-model attributes its matching record explicitly reports. Quote the record, model/registration identifier, field and value. Lenovo PSREF is Tier 1 for exact Lenovo configurations. Tier 1b: Wi-Fi Alliance, Bluetooth SIG, FCC ID regulatory records (fcc.gov, fccid.io for rated battery capacities and technical radio filings), USB-IF, Qi/WPC, and Apple MFi. Tier 2: Wikidata, the public Google Play supported-devices CSV, and Open Products Facts are identity/model/variant resolution only; never fill specification cells from them. Tier 3: Wikipedia, GSMArena, PhoneDB, DisplaySpecifications, RTINGS, SoundGuys, iFixit, 52audio, DPReview, and exact-configuration listings from the established retailers named in the category policy are approved fallback evidence, not merely leads. A Tier 3 source may directly support and fill a field when no applicable Tier 1/Tier 1b source provides that field and no Tier 1/Tier 1b conflict exists. Search applicable Tier 1/Tier 1b sources for that field first; record the source URLs checked and state in fallbackReason why they did not provide usable evidence. Tier 3 may support explicit positive or negative statements only when the source directly states them for the exact model; never infer No from silence. Check exact model/configuration, source context, units, conditions; distinguish independent testing/reporting from user-generated content. For every value return sourceTier (1, 1b, or 3), sourceType, and for Tier 3 fallback values a concise fallbackReason. Keep source URLs and exact identifiers; never merge variants.';
return m.products.map(product=>({json:{...m,product,gatewayRequest:{model:'gpt-6-luna',tools:[{type:'web_search'}],include:['web_search_call.action.sources'],max_tool_calls:48,max_output_tokens:30000,reasoning:{effort:'high'},instructions,input:JSON.stringify({category:m.category,product,fields:m.fields})}}}));

messageValues.message: Audit only the supplied per-column candidate list and its cited research evidence. The research stage already visited these websites; do not fetch the same sources again. Each input row is one field candidate. Check exact product/configuration, field meaning, quote/value agreement, units, conflicts, variant scope, negative evidence, enum fit and suspicious precision. Prioritize weak, ambiguous, conflicting, variant-sensitive, inferred, Tier 3, or explicitly unverified candidates. For straightforward exact-configuration Tier 1/Tier 1b candidates directly matching the quote, mark verified without generic caveats. Tier 3 sources are approved fallback evidence under the source policy: when a Tier 3 quote directly states the value for the exact model and no Tier 1/Tier 1b evidence conflicts, mark it verified; do not downgrade a candidate only because it is Tier 3. Each field definition contains the company's rules (for example: consumer electronics without certified drop testing are Shockproof=false; IPX4 is not waterproof); a candidate that applies such a rule is verified when no evidence contradicts it, even if the quote does not state the negative directly. Citation records are checked separately by the workflow; judge only whether the quote supports the value for this product. Retain every plausible but uncertain candidate as review; reject only clearly unsupported, wrong-field or empty/null candidates. Negative values: when the quote is the manufacturer's complete list of physical components of one kind (ports/interfaces, wireless radios, cameras) and a component of that kind is absent from it, a false/Ne/0/'Nėra' candidate is verified. Never verify that a feature or function (fast charging, wireless charging, step counting/pedometer, payments, water resistance) is absent only because the source does not mention it; such a negative needs an explicit statement or a company rule. Step counting by any built-in sensor means Pedometer true. Exact unit conversions (e.g. 64 MB = 0.064 GB, days to hours) are verified when the arithmetic is exact. Company category rules (apply them like field rules; a candidate that follows them is verified when no evidence contradicts it): Mobile devices (phones, tablets, watches): Barcode_sensor and Air_humidity_sensor are false; Shockproof is false unless the manufacturer states military-standard (MIL-STD-810) shock or drop testing in any wording, and a negative must not be verified when the evidence mentions military-standard testing; Thermometer_sensor is true when the manufacturer lists a temperature sensor or temperature measurement (including skin temperature), otherwise false. Wi-Fi-only tablets and laptops: cellular fields are false, SIM_count 0, SIM_type 'Nėra'. Smartwatches: EDGE and GPRS are false; models without LTE have eSIM false; documented 5ATM or more supports Waterproof true. Laptops and TVs: legacy interfaces (Firewire, DVI, SCSI, Optical drive, VGA, 3D_View) are 0 or false. Feature phones (keypad phones with a non-smartphone OS): Fingerprint_sensor, Face_recognition_sensor, Gyroscope, Compass, Barometer and Pedometer are false unless the manufacturer lists them; a phone whose only camera is the main camera has Front_camera 'Nėra'. Category specific rules: In-ear earbuds do not have stereo speakers (Stereo_speakers=false) and unbranded earbuds have Audio_system='Nėra'. For laptops, complete exact-SKU graphics listing without a dedicated GPU can support Discrete_video_card='Nėra', and a laptop webcam is Front_camera/Main_camera. Compound multi-material enums (like Materials confirming constituent components, e.g. plastic casing and silicone tips mapping to 'Plastikas, silikonas, metalas') are status: verified with verdict: ok. Map enum synonyms to listed choices when one matches; if a verified value is not among choices, keep it exactly as found and mark it verified when the quote supports it. Output ONLY JSON: {"values":{"field_key":{"value":...,"quote":"unchanged quote","url":"unchanged URL","status":"verified|review","reason":"..."}},"rejected":{"field_key":{"reason":"..."}}}. Do not alter the candidate value, quote or URL.
